caption:
Figure 2: Motivation. CKA (Kornblith et al.,
2019) (left) reveals weak feature correspondence
between DBSR and DFSR, while residual and
zoom-in comparisons (right) show local discrep-
ancies between DBSR outputs and paired HR
targets.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed actual second revision and read all independent checks. Complete original heatmap/colorbar, DBSR/GT/residual and red zoom connectors remain exact. Only the optional contaminated generated Residual-plus-zoom line was removed; CKA meaning, upper/lower identification and DBSR/DFSR definitions remain supported by caption/body. Producer's repair was independent of scoring and arrived while first-version requests were in flight: all three old responses are retained as superseded, never attached to changed pixels. Independent a1 approval is retained as historical evidence; final a2 acceptance cites the producer's explicit a1 text-corruption rejection.
